classes.name: FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: Implements entitlement consumption following FIFO logic for leave management in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the DAO object used for database interactions related to entitlement consumption strategy.

methods.name: handleLeaveCreate
methods.description: Processes new leave requests by allocating entitlements in FIFO order, updating days used, and returning the current and changed entitlements.

methods.name: handleEntitlementStatusChange
methods.description: Placeholder for handling changes in entitlement status, not implemented.

methods.name: handleLeaveCancel
methods.description: Reverts leave consumption, adjusts entitlements accordingly, and prepares data structures reflecting the cancellations.

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Updates leave period information based on date changes.

methods.name: getLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates date limits for leave without entitlement within a given balance period.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave period for a given date.
